scope: Read-only bounded metadata + reference samples. No full parquet downloads, training, OCR inference, benchmark error analysis, or line-label generation.

benchmark.use_policy: Frozen test only; never use benchmark labels, images, crops or errors for training, selecting alignments, thresholds, vocabulary or hyperparameters.

supervision_findings.synthetic_boxes_claim_in_card: Card describes OCRSmith generating bounding boxes, but the released schema/tree exposes no boxes or sidecar annotation files.
supervision_findings.newline_conclusion: None of the inspected train/validation strings contain LF/CR/Unicode line separators. This is an observation on the bounded sample, not a claim that every dataset row lacks newlines.
supervision_findings.ctc_readiness: Not directly usable as line-image/line-text pairs. Multi-line pictures plus flat transcriptions require verified alignment, upstream layout annotations, or controlled regeneration.

licensing.data_announced: Apache 2.0 badge in dataset README; no license YAML field or standalone license file at inspected revision.
licensing.benchmark_announced: README licensing section explicitly says Apache 2.0; no standalone license file at inspected revision.
licensing.source_provenance: Authors describe synthetic OCRSmith data and real-world book/social/education/cookbook data with Gemini pseudo-labeling and human correction. These are source-card claims, not independently revalidated annotation quality.
licensing.attribution: Imane Momayiz, Soufiane Ait Elaouad, Abdeljalil Elmajjodi, Haitame Bouanane; AtlasIA, AtlasOCR, 2025. Benchmark additionally credits Zaid Chiech.

bench_test_rows.method: SHA-256 of exact unnormalized UTF-8 reference text; dimensions compared, no OCR predictions or error analysis.

bench_test_offset55_rows.method: SHA-256 of exact unnormalized UTF-8 reference text; dimensions compared, no OCR predictions or error analysis.

overlap_policy: Reserve atlasOCR-data/test (196) and all AtlasOCRBench (251) regardless of sampled overlap; deduplicate candidate train/validation against frozen held-out sets by original image hashes and normalized transcripts before adaptation.
safe_next_steps: Prefer obtaining original OCRSmith line/word bounding boxes plus exact rendered line strings at a pinned source revision; they are absent from the released Hugging Face schema.

Alternatively regenerate new synthetic single-line images using atlasOCR-data/train strings only, preserving the exact emitted Unicode text and recording renderer/font/bidi/seed/source-row provenance. This is newly generated data, not recovered original line ground truth.

For existing multi-line images, detect geometric line candidates, remove decorative rules and assign top-to-bottom reading order. Use model proposals and constrained monotonic text alignment only as suggestions; manually verify each crop and transcription before accepting supervised line pairs.

Keep validation source pages separate before deriving crops, manually annotate validation line pairs, quarantine ambiguous/title/multicolumn/missing-text cases, and never distribute flat paragraph text across crops by equal word counts or guessed wrapping.

If verified per-line labels cannot be recovered, retain the page/paragraph supervision and use a recognizer designed for multi-line sequence decoding rather than presenting guesses as line ground truth.
limits: Only first --rows train/validation and two bounded benchmark windows inspected; these may overrepresent synthetic data.
No full-corpus duplicate/provenance audit; no general claim of split independence.
Signed cached-asset URLs expire; refetch rows to recover new preview links at the recorded revision.
A newline, if present in another row, is not by itself verified alignment to a visual baseline.
Image cached previews may be transcoded; matched cached-file hashes corroborate sampled image identity but do not replace original-parquet byte hashing.

manual_visual_check.inspector: Codex visual inspection of cached previews via view_image
